origin.description: Mark a length-one vector so it is encoded as a scalar.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: One atomic value, or a data frame with one row.

origin.details: A longer vector is an error. NULL is returned unchanged.
origin.value: The same value, marked as a scalar.

translation.description: Returns a Scalar. toJSON writes that value without brackets.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: One atomic value, or a data frame with one row.

translation.details: A list or dict is an error. None is returned unchanged.
translation.value: The same value, marked as a scalar.
